finding: All six continuation sources now have direct inspection and fresh replay evidence. Bounded independent checks support the stated finite results and corrections; a supplied assertion-dependent verifier defect and historical cost gaps remain explicit.
limitations: The old bounded review remains historically limited; the primary-source audit is a separate follow-up.
Independent checking covers the saved evidence and stated finite scopes, not every unsaved deduction or every historical run.
Guided 028 relies on assertions; optimized Python disables required supplied checks.

Toy 025 counts shared nodes under one fixed source-node identity per input clause; the three-node case is open. Its minimum-length dependency uses a published result whose original search was not reproduced.
One Doorway Run 025 cost and miss figures remain attributed; operation categories and replay timing do not establish total runtime savings.
Charters and conceptual spokes are not proof of independently launched workers.
method: Synthesis of six retained charters and a new primary-source follow-up: exact source custody, unchanged program replay, independently authored finite checks and explicit historical dependencies.
open_questions: Does an eleven-inference Toy 025 refutation use three shared nodes under the fixed model?
What remains useful after acquisition, verification and maintenance costs are counted?
Can the remaining historical Run 025 comparisons be recovered and checked independently?
